newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Thursday with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims data, dealers said.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended July 19 was forecast to be around 333,000 compared with 349,000 reported in the previous week.

"Rates were steady to a little bit softer in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the weekly jobless claims figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday and weekend eased 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent. Week-fixed eased 1/16 point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, four-months eased 1/16 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16, six-months was unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 and twelve-months eased 1/16 point to 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent.
